entries.name: IBIO-600
entries.stage: Phase 1; registry recruiting as last updated 29 May 2026
entries.summary: A subcutaneous anti-myostatin/GDF11 antibody being studied in adults with overweight or obesity. iBio announced first-participant dosing on 2 June 2026. NCT07487376 records a randomised single-ascending-dose trial with 32 estimated participants and no posted results.
entries.limitations: An older coverage omission, not a new October launch. Human muscle-preservation benefits and GLP-1 combination efficacy are unestablished. Registry estimated completion is May 2027; the sponsor's June release expected the second half of 2027. Preserve both estimates and verify later progress; do not treat either as completed.

fields.name: Survodutide
fields.stage: Phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE-2 results; separate MASH programme
fields.summary: Zealand reported SYNCHRONIZE-2 results on 1 October 2026: in adults with obesity/overweight and type 2 diabetes, mean weight loss reached 13.1% versus 3.1% with placebo at 76 weeks under the efficacy estimand. Gastrointestinal adverse events led to discontinuation in 18% versus 1.2%.
fields.limitations: Sponsor report; reported statistical tests were nominal; efficacy estimand assumes continued treatment. The linked NEJM paper was unavailable in this review. Cardiovascular outcomes were still expected later in 2026. No cross-trial ranking or transfer of obesity results to MASH.

fields.name: Trevogrumab with semaglutide, with or without garetosmab
fields.stage: Phase 2 COURAGE; new 52-week findings reported 1 October 2026
fields.summary: Regeneron reported less lean-mass loss with low-dose trevogrumab plus semaglutide. At 52 weeks, DXA lean-mass change was -4.2% with 75 mg versus -7.3% with placebo plus semaglutide. MRI thigh-muscle volume is a separate measure. Further Phase 2 research in older adults is planned.
fields.limitations: Sponsor report; Lancet paper in press, not independently read. Imaging does not establish improved strength or function. The 2025 garetosmab triplet had more discontinuations and two deaths; causation was not established. New low-dose results do not resolve that safety signal or establish tolerability superiority.
